aboutParagraphs: I'm a fourth-year BS Computer Science student at STI College San Jose. For our thesis I'm leading the programming of Zero Trust, Infinite Risk, a first-person cybersecurity awareness game in Unity and C#.
I also design interfaces and learn new tools quickly under pressure.

projects.title: Zero Trust, Infinite Risk
projects.shortDescription: A first-person cybersecurity awareness game built with Unity and C#.
projects.description: Our thesis game. You play through everyday school situations where every message, link and device could be a trap. The game teaches players to recognize real cyber threats (phishing, ransomware, QR code scams and USB drop attacks), and their choices lead to positive or negative endings. I led the programming, built the game's interface and wrote the system documentation.
highlights: Led the programming of the whole game in Unity and C#
Programmed 13 lessons on real cyber threats, with choice-based positive and negative endings
Covers phishing, ransomware, QR code scams and USB drop attacks
Authored the game's interface and the system documentation

projects.title: Ghost Catcher
projects.shortDescription: A 2D ghost-catching arcade game for PC and phone browsers.
projects.description: Ghost Catcher is a 2D game where players throw a lasso to catch ghosts and fill a jar before time runs out. I built it in Unity 6 with C#, with 10 levels, a coin shop with 6 hooks, an online leaderboard and a phone-friendly layout, then published it on itch.io with a gameplay teaser.
highlights: Built the lasso, ghost and jar gameplay in C#, across 10 levels that get harder
Added a coin shop with 6 hooks, saved progress and an online leaderboard
Made it play on PC and phone browsers and published it on itch.io

projects.title: DriveMate Car Rental
projects.shortDescription: UI/UX for a self-drive and with-driver car rental mobile app.
projects.description: DriveMate is a car rental app where customers can rent a car to drive themselves or book one with a driver. I designed the app's UI/UX in Figma and Canva, covering the main screens for listings, owner verification, price checks and booking, and built a customer persona from interviews with students and workers.
highlights: Designed screens for listings, owner verification, price checks and booking
Built a customer persona from interviews with students and workers
